episodes.title: Lady Comes to Town
episodes.summary: Griselda flees Medellín for Miami to make a fresh start. With her sons and a hidden cache in tow, she seizes a chance to establish her own business.

episodes.title: Rich White People
episodes.summary: Griselda welcomes some well-supplied Medellín associates to Miami, but an enemy isn't far behind. A night out fuels a bold plan to tap into a new market.

episodes.title: Mutiny
episodes.summary: After Griselda receives a tempting offer from a big-time supplier, she tries to win over a business rival and earn the trust of the local dealers.

episodes.title: Middle Management
episodes.summary: Griselda hides out in a secure compound and prepares to make her move against the Ochoas. June joins an elite tactical unit targeting drug traffickers.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.summary: Griselda suspects there's an informant in her ranks as June and CENTAC gain ground. A lavish, coke-fueled birthday party descends into chaos.

episodes.title: Adios, Miami
episodes.summary: Feeling pressure from all sides, Griselda gets out of Miami. But with her options dwindling and enemies closing in, can she outrun fate?
